# Pulse task #2868: Create Console track columns from sample/device drops with insertion previews

Operation: eac1a613597eadf9dd1781a49be95ae6
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User19October2026: Console should support creating tracks by dropping samples or devices, using the same intent as Arrange but with vertical track columns. Dropping in the free area to the right, between tracks, or before the first track should create a new track at that position. A sample/clip drop should show where the clip would land: real-looking clip preview in empty space; a highlighted insertion line between columns; small highlighted insertion region before the first column. Feedback must make destination obvious before drop.

Duplicate/context checked:2814/PR420 owns existing Console empty/occupied cell drops and between/bottom SCENE ROW insertion (nowDone); this request adds NORMAL TRACK COLUMN creation/insertion, not duplicate row logic or reopening its acceptance.2333 covers Arrange new-track/device drops;2795/PR401 track-header device append is distinct. Reuse existing canonical creation/import/device/Session commands and dragpayload types, shared project geometry/time/media paths. New tracks otherwise stay empty per2802; explicit device drop is deliberate device assignment, not automatic default Sine insertion.

Resolve track insertion index plus actual scene row/slot from Console geometry. Between normalcolumns inserts there; leading edge inserts before first; trailing/free normal-track column space appends. Existing empty/occupied clip SLOT remains existing2814 create/replace in that track, not arbitrarynewtrack just because the cell is empty. Between/below scenes keeps2814 row semantics; if a required target row must be created, use its existing explicit canonical row policy. Keep pinned Return/Main tracks and their ordering/routing distinct from normalcolumns; no inserting ordinary tracks into an invalid Return/Main region. Horizontal scrolling/column widths/emptyproject and resized view must use SAME target resolver as preview and commit, not separate approximate math.

Samples/actual supported clip payloads create correctly placed playable clips on the new track. Instruments/effects create a normal track with the explicitly dropped device in its proper canonical chain/slot; do not invent empty MIDI/audio clips or extra default instruments unless existing deliberate creation law requires it. Enumerate actual supported payloads and give clear unsupported refusal. Snapshot project generation/revision/insertion context atdrop so async decode cannot retarget based on later hover/selection. Keep existing content until valid atomic creation/import completes; one coherent Undo/Redo restores/removes newtrack+clip/device and any neededrow, no orphanmedia/project mutations on failure.

Hover preview is view-only: no realtrack/clip/device allocation/history edits per pointermove. Empty-space clip ghost represents intended size/row/column within feasible preview metadata; dividers/leadingregion use Hextheme and staystable without reflow. Clear ghost/insertion target/autoscroll on success/refusal/decodefailure/cancel/Escape/outside drop/view orprojectchange andstalecompletion; no stuckghostregression. Preserve Arrange/browseraudition andexisting Console cell/scene behavior.

Acceptance actual rendered pointer/targetpreview + realworker canonical drop/history for sample/device atleftfirst/between/rightempty, emptyConsole, scrolled/narrow/resizedcolumns, existing empty/occupiedslotcontrols, scene-boundary precedence, Returns/Mainrefusal, supportedpayloadmatrix, async targetcapture/staleproject/failure/cancel cleanup. Verify playableaudio/explicitdeviceidentity andoneUndoRedo whereapplicable; previewposition mustequalcommittedtarget. Affectedfocusedlocalchecks then solemerger currentexactqualification/review/merge. Readyonlyactualmerge; optimizednativevisual/inputacceptance separate.

Existing generalUIworker queues aftercurrent310/455/newresize andotherauthorizedUI work, onewriter/3workers. Supportedcanonicalintake/attach/sourceidentity beforeimplementation. Return genuine unsupported atomic creation/majorownership contract toRoot before publicframework expansion. No native/app/install/quit/hostedCI, no sharedinstrumentarchitecture/schema/migration redesign.
